description: This file defines the GceFuture class, a generic subclass of AbstractFuture used for managing asynchronous operations within the Google Cloud Engine (GCE) service. It includes methods for setting results or exceptions, canceling operations, and converting a list of GceFuture instances to a string.

classes.name: GceFuture
classes.description: A subclass of AbstractFuture that adds custom logging, cancellation handling, and a utility method for string representation of a list of GceFuture instances.

methods.name: GceFuture
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GceFuture with a given name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name associated with this GceFuture instance.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the result value of the future; logs an error if multiple sets are attempted.

methods.name: set (Exception)
methods.description: Sets an exception as the result of the future; logs a warning if the future is already completed.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Attempts to cancel the future by setting a CancellationException; does not support interruption.

methods.name: isCancelled
methods.description: Checks if the future was canceled by examining if it is done and if the cause was a CancellationException.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a list of GceFuture objects into a comma-separated string of their names.
